source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    line = set()
    for c in range(w):
        if grid[0][c] == 1 and grid[h - 1][c] == 1:
            line.update((r, c) for r in range(h))
    for r in range(h):
        if grid[r][0] == 1 and grid[r][w - 1] == 1:
            line.update((r, c) for c in range(w))
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 2 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            component = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                component.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] == 2 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            if any(cell in line for cell in component):
                for y, x in component:
                    out[y][x] = 1
    for r, c in line:
        out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
